usage: The word 銅 (tung4) is used as a noun to refer to copper, a type of metal.
銅 is often used in compound words related to items or materials made of copper.
In Cantonese, 銅 can describe the material composition of objects, such as 銅線 (copper wire).
It can also appear in idiomatic expressions or phrases related to value or function.
When discussing metals in general, 銅 is one of the common metals mentioned alongside others like 鐵 (iron).
